changes.title: Lantern-Differentialgleichung mit geprüftem RK4-Verfahren
changes.before: Integration: explicit Euler, dt = 0.02, only after a convergence proof
changes.after: Integration of the study: classical fourth-order Runge-Kutta (dynamics.integrate_rk4), dt = 0.02, same noise-free ODE and the same validated drift as the Euler path
changes.reason: Euler failed the ODE-accuracy gate (<= 0.005 rad) over the 32-case panel fixed before the run: 0.1165 (dt 0.02), 0.0606 (0.01), 0.0309 (0.005); first order. RK4 on the UNCHANGED panel: 3.244e-7 (dt 0.02), 2.068e-8 (0.01), 1.388e-9 (0.005); fourth order.
changes.euler_path: unchanged; its original-equivalence test (1.6e-14 <= 1e-12) stays the evidence for the Euler implementation; RK4 is NOT required to equal the original Euler steps

runtime.batch: 256 episodes, 34 nodes, t = 10, this PC, 2 BLAS threads
runtime.assessment: RK4 costs ~3.7x Euler per step at the same dt; Euler would need dt ~ 0.0009 (~24x the steps) for the gate, so RK4 is ~6x cheaper for the required accuracy (estimate from first-order scaling, Euler at dt 0.00125 still ~0.007) -- an extrapolation, not a measured comparison of two sufficiently accurate methods (review REVIEW_LR1_RK4)

checks_for_rk4: remote linear transfer at small amplitude
changes.decoder_metric_note: plan 10.2 also requires a decoder metric change <= 0.01 on the same development test panel; a passed state gate does not close it
changes.status: implemented before the freeze; part of the freeze candidate (LR6)
